table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	SaleType = 1,
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end,
	itemprefferedsaleqty=(select prefferedsaleqty  from item  where item.icode=saledetail.icode),
	AliasName = item.customicode,
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	users.username,   
	accounts.name, 
	headerno =max(saleledger.headerno),
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=ISNULL(max(saleledger.balance), 0), 
	amt=max(saleledger.amt),  
	printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	srbufferinvcode=dbo.saleledger.srbufferinvcode,
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode,
	salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=max(saleledger.smancode)),
	deliveredby=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=max(saleledger.deliveredby)),
	customername=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=saleledger.custcode)  ,
	customeralias=(select aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=saleledger.custcode)  ,
	customerphone=(select phone from customer where customer.custcode=saleledger.custcode),
	county=(select name from county,customer where saleledger.custcode=customer.custcode and county.countycode=customer.countycode),
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	patient=max(patient.name),
	doctor=max(doctors.name),
	patientregno=max(patient.regno),
	locationcode=max(patient.locationcode),
	InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	CashTendered = max(saleledger.CashTendered),
	CashCharged = CASE WHEN saleledger.salecatcode = 3 THEN max(saleledger.CashReceived) ELSE max(saleledger.CashCharged) END,
	CashBack = max(saleledger.CashBack),
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = SaleLedger.SaleInvCode), 0),
	ReturnAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetSRBufferInvTotal(saleledger.srbufferinvcode), 0)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Doctors ON (dbo.saleledger.doctcode = dbo.Doctors.doctcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Patient ON (dbo.saleledger.Patientcode = dbo.Patient.Patientcode),
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )  and
	( saleledger.admissioncode IS NULL)
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.salecatcode,
	dbo.saleledger.srbufferinvcode,
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	SaleType = 2,
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end,
	itemprefferedsaleqty=(select prefferedsaleqty  from item  where item.icode=srbufferdetail.icode),
	AliasName = item.customicode,
	reprintdate=getdate(),
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	headerno =max(dbo.srbufferledger.headerno),
	posted=max(dbo.srbufferledger.posted),
	balance=ISNULL((SELECT SS.Balance FROM SaleLedger SS WHERE SS.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	amt=ISNULL((SELECT SS.Amt FROM SaleLedger SS WHERE SS.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	printbalance=ISNULL((SELECT SS.printbalance FROM SaleLedger SS WHERE SS.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	saleinvcode = s.saleinvcode,   
	srbufferinvcode=dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode,
	dbo.srbufferledger.date,   
	saleledger_discperc = ISNULL((SELECT S.Discperc FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	saleledger_misccharges = ISNULL((SELECT S.misccharges FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	saleledger_flatdisc = ISNULL((SELECT S.flatdisc FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),   
	saleledger_salestax = ISNULL((SELECT S.salestax FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	dbo.srbufferledger.custcode,   
	dbo.srbufferledger.remarks,
	saleledger_custrefno = ISNULL((SELECT S.custrefno FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), ''),   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.icode,   
	dbo.srbufferdetail.gcode,
	salecatcode=max(S.Salecatcode),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.srbufferdetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(srbufferdetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = 0, 
	packunits = max(srbufferdetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(srbufferdetail.srprice), 
	rate      = 0,
	salestax  = max(srbufferdetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(srbufferdetail.discperc), 
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=max(S.smancode)),
	deliveredby=(select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=max(S.deliveredby)),
	customername=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=srbufferledger.custcode)  ,
	customeralias=(select aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=srbufferledger.custcode)  ,
	customerphone=(select phone from customer where customer.custcode=srbufferledger.custcode),
	county=(select name from county,customer where srbufferledger.custcode=customer.custcode and county.countycode=customer.countycode),
	itemflatdisc  = 0.00,
	unitsalestax  = max(srbufferdetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(srbufferdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = ISNULL((SELECT S.invgstperc1 FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	reprintcounter=NULL,
	patient=max(patient.name),
	doctor=NULL,
	patientregno=max(patient.regno),
	locationcode=max(patient.locationcode),
	InvTotal = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(:ra_InvCode), 0),
	CashTendered = ISNULL((SELECT S.CashTendered FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	CashCharged = ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN s.salecatcode = 3 THEN S.CashReceived ELSE S.CashCharged END FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	CashBack = ISNULL((SELECT S.CashBack  FROM SaleLedger S WHERE S.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode), 0),
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode), 0),
	ReturnAmt = ISNULL(DBO.fn_GetSRBufferInvTotal(srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode), 0)
FROM 
	(SELECT SL.* FROM SaleLedger SL WHERE SL.SaleInvCode = :ra_InvCode AND SL.SRBufferInvCode >= 0) S,
	dbo.srbufferledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.Patient ON (dbo.srbufferledger.Patientcode = dbo.Patient.Patientcode),
	dbo.srbufferdetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = S.srbufferinvcode ) AND
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode  = dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( srbufferdetail.icode = item.icode )  and
	( srbufferledger.admissioncode IS NULL) 
	
GROUP BY 
	srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode, 
	srbufferledger.saleinvcode, 
	s.saleinvcode, 
	srbufferledger.date, 
	srbufferledger.custcode, 
	srbufferledger.discperc, 
	srbufferledger.flatdisc, 
	srbufferledger.misccharges, 
	srbufferledger.salestax, 
	srbufferledger.remarks,
	srbufferledger.custrefno, 
	srbufferdetail.icode, 
	srbufferdetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	dbo.users.username

ORDER BY 
	SaleType, ID

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: t_21
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(if(saletype=1,(looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  * (saledetail_discperc  * .01 ),0) for all) >0,1,0)

objects.name: t_24

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval

objects.expression: if(saletype=1, Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), 0)

objects.name: t_23

objects.name: compute_17

objects.expression: sum(if(saletype=1,(looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *    (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 ),0) for all)

objects.name: compute_18

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: sum(if(saletype=1, (looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *    (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 ),0) for all)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: if(salecatcode <> 3, abs(balance + c_nettotal - amt - cashcharged - cardscharged), c_nettotal)
